incident: The learning compiler selected HISTORICAL_REPLAY, SHADOW and CANARY requirements, but policy promotion was not yet database-blocked when required evaluation evidence was absent.
root_cause: Evaluation mode was advisory output of powerhouse_learning_compiler_v1 rather than a state-transition invariant on powerhouse_policy_versions.
prevention_rule: A policy version may enter promoted only when the existing learning compiler's required evaluation mode has GREEN evidence bound to the exact candidate policy version and effect snapshot.

related_incidents.observation: Required and Shared Agent Memory detected tests/regulatory-organism-feed.test.mjs existed but was referenced by no workflow, so the regression contract never executed.
related_incidents.root_cause: A new regulatory organism regression was added without updating the explicit CI lane inventory.
related_incidents.prevention: Run the regulatory organism regression in the canonical backend lane; delivery-test-coverage-guard remains the fail-closed detector for future orphan tests.
